question: Build a trailing-twelve-month (TTM) comp table for four U.S. restaurant companies: Darden Restaurants, Brinker International, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store and The Cheesecake Factory. For each company compute TTM revenue (total revenues / net sales) and TTM GAAP net income attributable to the company, both in USD millions, through the company's most recent fiscal quarter reported as of October 3, 2026. Define TTM as the last four reported fiscal quarters, i.e. latest fiscal year + current fiscal year-to-date - prior-year year-to-date (when the most recent reported quarter is the fiscal fourth quarter, TTM equals that fiscal year); do not adjust for 52/53-week differences. State the TTM end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
TTM through each company's most recent reported quarter (USD millions):

**Question:** Build a trailing-twelve-month (TTM) comp table for four U.S. restaurant companies: Darden Restaurants, Brinker International, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store and The Cheesecake Factory. For each company compute TTM revenue (total revenues / net sales) and TTM GAAP net income attributable to the company, both in USD millions, through the company's most recent fiscal quarter reported as of October 3, 2026. Define TTM as the last four reported fiscal quarters, i.e. latest fiscal year + current fiscal year-to-date - prior-year year-to-date (when the most recent reported quarter is the fiscal fourth quarter, TTM equals that fiscal year); do not adjust for 52/53-week differences. State the TTM end date used for each company.
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** TTM = last four reported fiscal quarters, computed as latest fiscal year + current fiscal-year-to-date − prior-year fiscal-year-to-date, with no 52/53-week adjustment. Darden: most recent reported quarter is Q1 FY2027 (ended 2026-08-30, 10-Q filed 2026-10-02), so TTM = FY2026 + Q1 FY2027 − Q1 FY2026; TTM end date 2026-08-30. Brinker: most recent reported quarter is fiscal Q4 FY2026 (ended 2026-06-24, 10-K filed 2026-08-19); Q1 FY2027 ended 2026-09-23 but is not yet reported, so TTM = FY2026; TTM end date 2026-06-24. Cracker Barrel: most recent reported quarter is fiscal Q4 FY2026 (ended 2026-07-31, 10-K filed 2026-09-25), so TTM = FY2026; TTM end date 2026-07-31. Cheesecake Factory: most recent reported quarter is Q2 FY2026 (ended 2026-06-30, 10-Q filed 2026-08-03); Q3 FY2026 ended 2026-09-29 but is not yet reported, so TTM = FY2025 + H1 FY2026 − H1 FY2025; TTM end date 2026-06-30. Revenue read as total revenues / net sales as reported; net income read as GAAP net income attributable to the parent company (after noncontrolling interests). All four are U.S. SEC registrants filing 10-K/10-Q; fiscal years are not calendar years (DRI ends late May, EAT late June, CBRL late July, CAKE late December).

- Darden Restaurants' most recent reported quarter as of October 3, 2026 is Q1 FY2027, the quarter ended August 30, 2026 (10-Q filed 2026-10-02), so its TTM window is FY2026 plus Q1 FY2027 minus Q1 FY2026 and the TTM end date is 2026-08-30. [7]
- Brinker International's most recent reported quarter as of October 3, 2026 is fiscal Q4 FY2026, the quarter ended June 24, 2026 (10-K filed 2026-08-19), so its TTM equals fiscal 2026 and the TTM end date is 2026-06-24. [8]
- Cracker Barrel Old Country Store's most recent reported quarter as of October 3, 2026 is fiscal Q4 FY2026, the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (10-K filed 2026-09-25), so its TTM equals fiscal 2026 and the TTM end date is 2026-07-31. [9]
- The Cheesecake Factory's most recent reported quarter as of October 3, 2026 is Q2 FY2026, the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (10-Q filed 2026-08-03), so its TTM window is FY2025 plus H1 FY2026 minus H1 FY2025 and the TTM end date is 2026-06-30. [10]
- No 52/53-week adjustment is applied: Darden's fiscal 2026 contained 53 weeks while fiscal 2027 contains 52 weeks, and each TTM figure is the arithmetic sum of the reported periods as filed. [11][7]
- For The Cheesecake Factory, net income attributable to parent equals total net income including noncontrolling interests in each of the three periods used, so the TTM figure is unaffected by the noncontrolling-interest treatment. [5][6]
